newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil weak, fuel oil gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil weak, fuel oil gains.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday morning, with heating oil falling with futures, while talk of short-covering lifted fuel oil, dealers said.
Heating oil barges were $1 a tonne lower as IPE July gas oil futures weakened. Premiums were still around IPE July +50 cents in quiet early business.

High sulphur fuel oil was offered at $85 fob for stored material and $86 fob Rotterdam for running refinery product. Dealers said the $1 gain was the result of possible short- covering. Bunker demand appeared poor.
